cards.front: Recall a key point about Earthquakes & Volcanoes
cards.back: Earthquakes occur when stress builds up at plate boundaries and is suddenly released as seismic waves

cards.front: Recall a key point about Earthquakes & Volcanoes
cards.back: The focus is the point underground where the earthquake originates; the epicentre is the point on the surface directly above

cards.front: Recall a key point about Earthquakes & Volcanoes
cards.back: Volcanoes form where magma reaches the surface: at divergent boundaries (fissure eruptions), subduction zones (explosive stratovolcanoes), and hotspots (shield volcanoes)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Earthquakes & Volcanoes
cards.back: Effusive eruptions produce fluid basaltic lava (e.g. Iceland); explosive eruptions produce viscous andesitic/rhyolitic lava, ash and pyroclastic flows (e.g. Mt St Helens)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Earthquakes & Volcanoes
cards.back: Earthquake hazards include ground shaking, liquefaction, landslides and tsunamis

cards.front: Recall a key point about Earthquakes & Volcanoes
cards.back: Volcanic hazards include lava flows, pyroclastic flows, ash falls, lahars and gas emissions
